name: 29206-decodeheavy-8b-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3, one GPU of an a3 node (--gres=gpu:1).
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1 -- one engine on one GPU.
architecture: Dense LlamaForCausalLM, 8.03B: 32 layers, 32 query / 8 KV heads (GQA), head_dim 128, full attention throughout. KV is 128 KiB per token.
load_profile: concurrent (CLOSED loop), streams=512, warmup the first 25% by request count, bounded at 10240 requests with a 1800 s safety cap. Paired with `max-num-seqs: 512` so the engine admits every in-flight request.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, no prefix buckets, seeded (scenario.json `seed: 29206`). Prompts exactly 128 tokens, outputs exactly 512 (EOS ignored), greedy. Requests go down the default chat route, whose template adds a few fixed tokens in front of the 128.
purpose: A long-form writing assistant generating 512-token replies from short prompts for 512 concurrent users on one GPU.
launch:
# Engine declaration. Read by a FLAT reader: every key stays top-level, and any
# structured value stays inline on ONE line.
model: NousResearch/Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct
max-num-seqs: 512
max-num-batched-tokens: 8192
tensor-parallel-size: 1
pipeline-parallel-size: 1
dtype: bfloat16
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
enable-prefix-caching: true
block-size: 16
async-scheduling: false
